title: Observability: set_tag taglen < 12 FIPS check is silent
description: ioctl_set_tag returns -EINVAL when op.taglen < 12 (FIPS SP 800-38D §5.2.1.2 minimum 96-bit tag) with no log. The comment at line 1134 documents the FIPS requirement, but there is no pr_info or pr_err emitted. A support engineer handed a ring buffer where SET_TAG returns -EINVAL cannot tell whether this is a FIPS constraint violation (taglen too small), a wrong taglen value (taglen > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN), or an invalid ioctl argument. Trigger: call SET_TAG with taglen < 12. Bad outcome: -EINVAL with no log, support engineer cannot diagnose FIPS compliance failure vs argument error. Fix: add pr_info_ratelimited logging taglen, algo, provider before the -EINVAL return. Location: crypto2dev_fd.c line 1135.
